## Purpose

Renders the Account Settings page — profile/password, AI model preference, usage & plan limits, and
the user's "constitution" (standing instructions prepended to every agent run). Mounted by
`DashboardLayout` for `mainView === "settings"`.

## Shape

- [AccountSettings.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/settings/AccountSettings.tsx) — one component with a `Tabs`-driven `section` state
  (`profile` | `model` | `limits` | `constitution`). Fetches `getMe`/`getPreferences`/`getCapabilities`
  once on mount; each section owns its own save flow (`changePassword`, `updatePreferences`) with its
  own success/error banner. The constitution tab is a nested `ConstitutionSection` component in the
  same file, calling `/api/settings/constitution` directly (GET/PUT/DELETE) rather than through
  `lib/api`.
- **Section tab mirrors the URL (spec 015-frontend-routing)**: `SECTION_ROUTE` maps each `section`
  value to its `routes.settings*()` URL (the reverse of what `parseViewPath` reads on cold mount);
  a tab click now pushes that URL so the address bar tracks which section is open, not just a
  fresh `/settings/{section}` navigation.

## Why this shape

**All four sections share one loading gate and one page shell**, so they're kept in a single component
rather than split into per-tab files — each section is a self-contained form with its own local state
and doesn't need to be reused elsewhere. `ConstitutionSection` is broken out as a nested function only
because it manages a distinct fetch/save/delete lifecycle against a different endpoint than the rest of
the page.
